## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context. List any migrations or schema changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Schema migration (non-breaking change which alters table structures)
- [ ] Stored procedure or trigger update
- [ ] Access control / role privileges change
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My SQL scripts follow the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own SQL scripts
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand triggers/SPs
- [ ] My changes generate no new database conflicts or constraint errors
- [ ] I have added regression tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] All database tests pass locally with my changes
